versions.localizedDescription:
Phase 2 — the log sheet and the bot rows.

• Settings ▸ View log can be re-read without closing it (Refresh) and read from either end — Newest first or Newest last, remembered per device.
• Swipe a bot row left to pin or unpin it, right to mark it unread. Icons only, no words. Marking unread lights one unread — the newest message — rather than the whole history.

Phase 1 — the bot menu.

• The pill that opens the bot panel now takes a click on its whole rectangle: the rounded ends used to be dead to the pointer, and a hover rescale moved the target while the pointer was arriving. Hover is now a brighter border and a deeper shadow, with no geometry change.
• The bot panel's column starts 30 pt below the window's top edge instead of sitting against it.
• ⌘E opens and closes the bot menu (Conversation ▸ Bot Menu), the same door the pill is.

Notifications reach you with the app closed: the host no longer believes a stale 'I am reading this bot' claim, and the app now drops that claim when it leaves the foreground. Root cause of the replies that went missing.

App icon is now white on black, and the sideload source's icon was regenerated with it — SideStore had been showing a blue mark from before the faces existed. Same build also carries the bot's face inside Hermey's own notification banners.

Hermey's own banners now carry the bot's face: each portrait is rendered once at launch, cached, and attached to the notification. (The corner icon stays the app icon — iOS chooses it, not the app.) Bark banners unchanged.
